title: Strict-perfect tensor model for finite reduction
statement: For every n and the coefficient datum [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], there exists a bounded complex P of completed coefficient module sheaves, with a specified finite-free retract splitting of each term, such that derived scalar extension to A/I^(n+1) followed by restriction is naturally isomorphic to finiteProjectiveTensorRight(P) of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-projective-tensor-products]. The assertion is independent of the input derived object.

proof.text: Choose the bounded finite-projective A-resolution provided by quotientPerfect. Bounded-above projectivity lifts its derived isomorphism to a quasi-isomorphism to the quotient in degree zero.

Apply constant sheaf realization followed by completed scalar extension. The completed constant reduction theorem gives a quasi-isomorphism to the restricted quotient, both bounds and finite-free retract splittings. Convert finite coproduct splittings into product splittings via the biproduct isomorphism.
Use the natural derived tensor comparison for the resulting augmentation.

theorem completedFiniteReductionTensorModel (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ (P : CochainComplex (adicDatumModules T d) ℤ)
      (hb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, j < a ∨ b < j → IsZero (P.X j))
      (p : SheafOfModules.StrictPerfectCoefficientPackageOnSite
        ((adicLisseForget T).obj (adicDatumRing T d)) P),
      Nonempty (adicDatumReductionUnderlying T d n ≅
        finiteProjectiveTensorRight T d P hb p)
